# Kanchi Gupta — Joint Commissioner, Indian Revenue Service (IRS)

> Kanchi Gupta is a Joint Commissioner in the Indian Revenue Service (IRS — Customs &
> Indirect Taxes, CBIC, Government of India), currently posted to Chennai CGST Audit
> (promoted 2 January 2026). She is an electrical engineer (B.Tech, VNIT Nagpur),
> postgraduate in technology and public policy (IIT Bombay, C-TARA), and a law graduate
> (LL.B., Government Law College Mumbai). She was inducted into the 2016 batch of the IRS
> through the Civil Services Examination (NACIN 68th Batch). Her professional work covers
> indirect taxation, customs, GST audit, SEZ/FTWZ compliance, and electoral expenditure
> oversight for the Election Commission of India.
